reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services. National coverage with city-level detail for major urban centres.
reports._notes: Flagship price statistic. July 2026: monthly variation 0.17%, year-to-date 4.94%, annual 6.03%. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco de la República and into the updating of poverty lines.

reports.title: Gran Encuesta Integrada de Hogares (GEIH) / Great Integrated Household Survey
reports.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators (employment, unemployment, informality, underemployment) and for the income data used in monetary-poverty measurement. National, urban-rural, regional and capital-city domains.
reports._notes: Central social and labour survey. Moving-quarter and monthly releases. Official source for both labour statistics and the income side of monetary poverty and inequality (Gini). Microdata regularly disseminated.

reports.title: Pobreza monetaria y pobreza monetaria extrema / Monetary poverty
reports.publisher: DANE + Comité de Expertos en Pobreza
reports.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from GEIH, augmented with administrative transfers) with nationally defined poverty lines. Annual publication with urban/rural and city breakdowns.
reports._notes: Headline social indicator. 2025 results published June 2026 with joint DANE–Expert Committee statement. Poverty lines updated with IPC; income concept includes labour, transfers and other sources. Series have undergone methodological empalmes after GEIH frame changes.

reports.title: Líneas de pobreza monetaria y pobreza extrema
reports.description: Monetary values of the poverty and extreme-poverty lines (per capita and for reference households), updated with the IPC and differentiated by geographic domain.
reports._notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. 2025 national per-capita extreme-poverty line ~$236,580; poverty line ~$482,041 (monthly). Domain-specific lines published for cabeceras and centros poblados/rural disperso.

reports.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Colombia
reports.description: Full system of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income, supply-and-use tables and institutional sector accounts. Quarterly and annual releases.
reports._notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. DANE is the primary compiler (unlike Chile where the central bank leads). Quarterly GDP and annual institutional accounts are the headline products.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Población y Vivienda / National Population and Housing Census
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline, sampling frames for household surveys, and small-area population estimates.
reports._notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by GEIH design, poverty analysis and departmental statistical work. Latest major census cycle and subsequent projections are the current reference.

reports.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) / Industrial Production Index
reports.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production (manufacturing, mining, electricity). Principal short-term activity indicator for the industrial sector.
reports._notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. Complements the broader activity measures and feeds into quarterly national accounts.

reports.title: Coeficiente de Gini / Income inequality
reports.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality, calculated from the same GEIH income concept used for monetary poverty. Published annually with the poverty results.
reports._notes: Companion inequality indicator to the poverty series. Released jointly with monetary poverty and extreme poverty under the Expert Committee process.

reports.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) — sector detail
reports.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production covering manufacturing, mining & quarrying, electricity & gas, and water. Published with sector contributions and year-to-date rates.
reports._notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. February 2026: 0.0% year-on-year overall; manufacturing +1.4%, electricity & gas +1.8%, water +2.2%. Built from EMMET and administrative registers.

reports.title: Encuesta Mensual Manufacturera con Enfoque Territorial (EMMET)
reports.description: Monthly sample survey of manufacturing establishments measuring production, sales, employment, wages and hours. Source for the manufacturing component of the IPI and for territorial industrial indicators.
reports._notes: Primary high-frequency manufacturing survey. Covers 39 CIIU domains and selected departments/metropolitan areas. Direct input into monthly IPI and quarterly national accounts.

reports.title: Encuesta Anual Manufacturera (EAM)
reports.description: Annual structural survey of manufacturing establishments providing production, intermediate consumption, value added, employment and energy use. Structural counterpart to the monthly EMMET.
reports._notes: Structural manufacturing baseline. 2024 provisional: ~6,583 establishments, production ~COP 444 trillion, value added ~COP 148 trillion. Used for national-accounts benchmarking and industrial structure analysis.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos y Posición de Inversión Internacional
reports.description: Quarterly balance of payments and international investment position. Covers current account, capital/financial account, and the stock of external assets and liabilities.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product. Q4 2025: current-account deficit USD 3.9 bn (3.1% of quarterly GDP). Full-year 2025 deficit ~USD 10.9 bn (2.4% of GDP). Net IIP negative ~USD 200 bn.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
reports.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods, by product, partner and customs regime. Primary real-side input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
reports._notes: Trade data feed both the BOP and the national accounts. Mining-energy exports remain a large share; recent years have seen widening goods deficits driven by stronger import growth.

reports.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (Banrep)
reports.description: Periodic Monetary Policy Report of the central bank. Explains the inflation outlook, the policy framework and the implications for the intervention interest rate.
reports._notes: Flagship policy communication product. Complements the post-meeting statements and minutes of the Junta Directiva. Central reference for the 3% inflation target and the path of the policy rate.

reports.title: Tasa de interés de intervención / Policy interest rate
reports.description: Main monetary-policy instrument of the Junta Directiva. The rate at which the central bank intervenes in the money market to manage liquidity and steer inflation toward the 3% target.
reports._notes: Operational policy rate. Recent levels in the low-to-mid teens after the post-2022 tightening cycle; path is the primary signal of the monetary stance.

reports.title: Reservas Internacionales del Banco de la República
reports.description: Stock of international reserves managed by the central bank under constitutional and legal mandate. Published at high frequency and analysed in the BOP and Board reports to Congress.
reports._notes: Key external-buffer indicator. End-2025 net reserves ~USD 66.4 bn (up ~USD 3.9 bn year-on-year). Adequacy metrics (IMF-style) regularly reported.

reports.title: Marco de metas de inflación (3%) — Banco de la República
reports.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: inflation targeting centred on 3% annual CPI inflation. Derived from the constitutional and legal mandate of the central bank.
reports._notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated.
_referenced_by: Every IPoM and monetary-policy decision statement
IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target

reports.title: Informe de la Junta Directiva al Congreso de la República
reports.description: Statutory twice-yearly report of the central-bank Board to Congress covering economic conditions, policy decisions, reserves, the Bank’s financial situation and outlook.
reports._notes: Accountability product required by law. March and July editions are the main formal channel from the Junta Directiva to the legislature.

reports.title: Bogotá D.C. — capital statistical identity
reports.description: Capital district and largest urban economy. Primary domain for GEIH labour and poverty cuts, with lower informal employment and lower monetary-poverty incidence than the national average.
reports._notes: Dominant metro node. Recent GEIH: unemployment ~8.8% (below national); informal employment among the lowest of the 23 cities (~33%). Monetary poverty incidence also lower than the national urban average. Continuously published as a distinct geographic domain.

reports.title: 13 ciudades y áreas metropolitanas — statistical domain
reports.description: Standard high-frequency geographic domain of the GEIH comprising Bogotá and the main metropolitan areas (Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, etc.). Core urban labour and poverty reporting frame.
reports._notes: Workhorse urban domain. Informal employment and unemployment rates for the 13 cities are the main urban benchmarks published monthly/quarterly alongside the national total.

reports.title: Medellín Área Metropolitana — statistical profile
reports.description: Second-largest metropolitan area. Regularly published as a distinct GEIH and poverty domain with intermediate informal-employment and poverty outcomes.
reports._notes: Key secondary metro. Completes the capital–second-city contrast inside the national urban hierarchy.

reports.title: Alianza del Pacífico (Protocolo Comercial)
reports.publisher: Estados miembros de la Alianza del Pacífico (Chile, Colombia, México, Perú)
reports.description: Regional integration initiative and commercial protocol among the four Pacific-facing Latin American economies. Preferential trade, investment and regulatory cooperation framework.
reports._notes: Latin American Pacific counterpart to MERCOSUR. Continuously cited in official trade reporting; bilateral trade with AP partners is tracked separately to avoid double-counting with existing bilateral FTAs.
_referenced_by: DANE–DIAN bilateral trade statistics with AP partners

reports.title: Tratado de Libre Comercio Colombia–Estados Unidos
reports.description: Bilateral free-trade agreement in force since 2012. Core preferential-access instrument for the US market and a recurring reference in trade and investment analysis.
reports._notes: Major bilateral FTA. Continuously cited in official trade-performance reporting and in discussions of non-mining export diversification.
_referenced_by: Export and import statistics by partner
Policy debates on US market access

reports.title: Producción y exportaciones de petróleo / Mining-energy exports
reports.publisher: DANE / Ministerio de Minas y Energía / Banrep
reports.description: Statistics of crude-oil and broader mining-energy production and exports. Structurally important component of merchandise exports and of the external accounts.
reports._notes: Commodity backbone of the export basket. Mining-energy share of total exports remains large; recent years have seen volume and price swings that dominate the goods-trade balance.

reports.title: Café — producción y exportaciones
reports.publisher: DANE / Federación Nacional de Cafeteros / MinCIT
reports.description: Statistics of coffee production and exports. Iconic non-mining agricultural export and a recurring line in trade and rural-economy analysis.
reports._notes: Signature soft-commodity export. Appears in both the agricultural and the non-mining-energy export aggregates and is continuously cited in rural and trade-policy discussion.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Calidad de Vida (ECV)
reports.description: Periodic multi-purpose household survey measuring living conditions, housing, education, health affiliation, subjective well-being and access to services. Complements GEIH on non-labour dimensions of welfare.
reports._notes: Key living-conditions survey. 2024 results cover health-service perception, education, housing deficit and subjective poverty. Published for national, Bogotá and departmental domains.

reports.title: Pruebas Saber / ICFES learning assessments
reports.description: National standardised assessments of student learning outcomes (Saber 11 and related). Principal learning-quality indicator for the school system.
reports._notes: Flagship education-quality statistic. Complements enrolment and attainment data from ECV and administrative sources. Continuously cited in education-policy evaluation.

reports.title: Departamento del Chocó — highest-poverty contrast
reports.description: Pacific department with the highest monetary-poverty incidence in the 2025 departmental results. Tests the statistical hierarchy under extreme marginalisation.
reports._notes: Poverty-contrast department. 2025 monetary poverty 65.3% (highest of the 23 reported departments); extreme poverty also the highest. National survey infrastructure reaches the department; independent local statistical density is thin.

reports.title: Departamento de La Guajira — high-poverty Caribbean contrast
reports.description: Northern Caribbean department with the second-highest monetary-poverty incidence. Completes the periphery contrast alongside Chocó.
reports._notes: 2025 monetary poverty 60.2%. Extreme poverty also elevated. Illustrates the Caribbean–Pacific poverty belt under a common national measurement framework.

reports.title: Departamento de Sucre — secondary high-poverty node
reports.description: Caribbean department ranking third in monetary poverty in the 2025 results.
reports._notes: 2025 monetary poverty 51.8%. Reinforces the Caribbean high-poverty cluster.

reports.title: Departamento de Cundinamarca — low-poverty contrast
reports.description: Andean department surrounding Bogotá with the lowest departmental monetary-poverty incidence in 2025.
reports._notes: 2025 monetary poverty 15.1% — lowest of the reported departments. Completes the capital-region low-poverty pole opposite Chocó/La Guajira.

reports.title: Departamento de Antioquia — core statistical identity
reports.description: Major Andean department centred on Medellín. Intermediate-to-low monetary poverty and a relatively dense urban statistical presence via the Medellín AM domain.
reports._notes: 2025 monetary poverty 19.2%. Hosts the second-largest metro and a significant share of manufacturing and services activity.

reports.title: Pobreza monetaria por departamento (DANE)
reports.description: Official departmental tabulations of monetary poverty and extreme poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.
reports._notes: Key homogeneity-test product. 2025 ranking (selected): Chocó 65.3%, La Guajira 60.2%, Sucre 51.8%, … Antioquia 19.2%, Bogotá 17.8%, Cundinamarca 15.1%. National average 28.0%.

reports.title: DIAN — recaudo tributario y aduanero
reports.publisher: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
reports.description: Tax and customs administration. Publishes gross and net tax collection by type of tax (income withholding, VAT, customs, etc.) and performance against annual targets.
reports._notes: Primary revenue-side fiscal statistic. 2025 gross collection ~COP 296 trillion (96.9% of target). Links the real-side economy to the central-government budget.

reports.title: Sistema General de Regalías / Royalties from hydrocarbons and mining
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Hacienda / DNP / Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos
reports.description: Royalties generated by hydrocarbon and mineral extraction and their distribution to producing and non-producing territorial entities. Major sub-national fiscal transfer mechanism.
reports._notes: Critical sub-national fiscal node. 2025 hydrocarbon royalties caused ~COP 8.5 trillion. Concentrated in Meta, Casanare, Santander, Arauca and Huila. Directly links the oil/mining production statistics to territorial budgets.

reports.title: Presupuesto General de la Nación / National Budget
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público
reports.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the central government.
reports._notes: Operational fiscal framework. Links tax collection (DIAN), royalties and other revenues with functional spending on education, health, social protection and investment.

reports.title: Departamento del Valle del Cauca — core statistical identity
reports.description: Major Pacific-Andean department centred on Cali. Intermediate monetary poverty and a significant metropolitan domain (Cali AM).
reports._notes: 2025 monetary poverty 21.8%. Completes the set of large departmental economies alongside Antioquia, Cundinamarca/Bogotá and the Caribbean departments.

dependencies.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from GEIH household income data (augmented with administrative transfers).
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita income with the official poverty and extreme-poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with the IPC.
The Gini coefficient is computed from the same income distribution underlying the poverty estimates.
EMMET is the primary survey source for the manufacturing component of the IPI.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
The Monetary Policy Report analyses outcomes against the 3% inflation target.
The intervention rate is the primary instrument used to steer inflation toward the target.
Pacific Alliance preferential trade is a recurring analytical dimension of merchandise-trade reporting.
The US FTA underpins preferential bilateral trade flows that appear in the trade statistics.
Chocó’s high poverty ranking is derived from the departmental poverty tabulations.
La Guajira’s high poverty ranking is derived from the departmental poverty tabulations.
Cundinamarca’s low poverty ranking is derived from the departmental poverty tabulations.
Royalties are generated by hydrocarbon and mineral production.
Tax collection is the primary revenue source of the national budget.

The dependency is real but runs the other way: the EMMET depends on the EAM. DANE's EMMET methodology states 'El marco estadistico que sirvio de base para el rediseno de la encuesta se conformo a partir de la informacion de la EAM de 2017', that establishments are coded using 'la clasificacion de actividad economica de cada establecimiento en la EAM', and that 'Como ponderador de la EMMET se tomo la relacion de valor agregado sobre la produccion bruta de la EAM del ano 2017'. The EAM methodology, by contrast, never mentions the EMMET.
